sections.title: Why React and Next.js in 2026?
sections.content:
React is the world's most popular JavaScript library for building user interfaces. According to the [Stack Overflow Developer Survey](https://survey.stackoverflow.co/), React remains the dominant web framework among professional developers, far ahead of Angular and Vue.js.

Next.js, Vercel's React framework, adds server-side rendering (SSR/SSG), automatic routing, image optimization and instant deployment. In 2026, [Next.js powers Netflix, TikTok, Twitch, Notion and thousands of SaaS products](https://nextjs.org/showcase).

Why this matters for your project: a Next.js application loads in under one second (LCP < 1s), ranks perfectly on Google thanks to server rendering, and scales from 10 to 100,000 users without architecture changes.

**N8N** — Business workflow automation: tool connections, scraping, notifications, AI agents.

**GSAP** — Smooth, performant animations for high-impact interfaces.

sections.title: Why Next.js + Supabase in 2026?
sections.content:
Next.js + Supabase has become the go-to stack for startups and SaaS in 2026. This duo replaces traditional architectures (Express + MongoDB, Django + PostgreSQL) with 3-5x higher productivity.

**Next.js** provides the frontend and server: server-side rendering (SSR), API Routes, Server Components, automatic image and code optimization. Average PageSpeed score: 98/100.

**Supabase** provides the complete backend: PostgreSQL database, authentication (email, OAuth, magic links), file storage, REST and real-time API, Edge Functions. It's the open-source Firebase alternative, adopted by over 1 million developers.

Together, they let you launch a functional MVP in 2-4 weeks, with an architecture that scales from 10 to 100,000 users without refactoring.

sections.title: What Supabase replaces
sections.content:
**Firebase** — Supabase offers the same features (auth, database, storage, real-time) but with PostgreSQL instead of Firestore. Advantage: standard SQL queries, no vendor lock-in, data exportable at any time.

**Custom backend (Express/NestJS)** — Supabase auto-generates REST and GraphQL APIs from your database schema. No need to write hundreds of CRUD routes manually.

**Auth0 / Clerk** — Supabase authentication is built-in and free: email/password, OAuth (Google, GitHub, Apple), magic links, 2FA. No third-party service to pay for.

**AWS S3** — Supabase storage handles uploads, image resizing and access permissions. Simple interface, consistent API with the rest of the stack.

For a deeper comparison, check my article: [Why Supabase replaces Firebase](/en/blog/pourquoi-supabase-remplace-firebase).

sections.title: Security and best practices
sections.content:
**Row Level Security (RLS)** — Every table has PostgreSQL policies ensuring users only access their own data. No authorization vulnerabilities possible.

**Strict TypeScript** — All code is typed. Errors are caught at compile time, not in production.

**Environment variables** — API keys and secrets are stored server-side, never exposed to the client.

**HTTPS + HSTS** — End-to-end encryption. Complete security headers (CSP, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy).

**Automatic backups** — Supabase performs daily database backups. One-click restore.

faq.question: Is Supabase reliable for production?
faq.answer: Yes. Supabase hosts over 1 million production projects. Infrastructure runs on AWS with a 99.9% SLA. Backups are automatic and restoration is one-click. It's standard PostgreSQL — the world's most reliable database.

faq.question: Can you migrate from Firebase to Supabase?
faq.answer: Yes. I handle Firebase → Supabase migrations: exporting Firestore data to PostgreSQL, migrating authentication, and adapting frontend code. The process typically takes 2-4 weeks depending on complexity.

faq.question: Is Supabase free?
faq.answer: Supabase offers a generous free tier: 500 MB database, 1 GB storage, 50,000 monthly active users and 2 million Edge Function invocations. For most MVPs and small SaaS products, the free tier is sufficient. Paid plans start at $25/month.

faq.question: What's the difference with Firebase?
faq.answer: Firebase uses Firestore (NoSQL) while Supabase uses PostgreSQL (relational SQL). PostgreSQL enables complex queries (JOINs, aggregations) impossible on Firestore. Supabase is open-source — your data is never locked to a vendor. And authentication is included for free without limits.

faq.answer: I primarily work with Claude (Anthropic) and GPT-4 (OpenAI) for text processing, content generation and AI agents. For computer vision, I use open-source models via Hugging Face. Model choice depends on your use case and budget.

faq.question: Is my company data secure?
faq.answer: Yes. I configure architectures where your data stays on your own servers. API calls to AI services (Claude, GPT) are encrypted in transit. For sensitive data, I use self-hosted open-source models that don't share anything with third parties.

faq.question: Do you offer AI system maintenance?
faq.answer: Yes. AI systems require monitoring: model updates, prompt adjustments, performance monitoring. I offer monthly maintenance contracts adapted to your system's complexity.

approach.title: THE APPROACH
approach.heading: From Webflow and Bubble to Claude Code: a no-code developer's approach, based in Madagascar
paragraphs: For four years, I delivered from Madagascar dozens of marketing sites and SaaS MVPs entirely in [no-code](/en/services/no-code-developer-madagascar). Webflow for premium sites, Bubble for business apps, [n8n to plug everything](/en/services/n8n-automation-expert-madagascar) into client tools. An approach proven with my French and international clients: iteration in days rather than months, clean delivery, and pricing that stays grounded.

Late 2025, Claude Code changed the game. After months of daily use on production projects, I watched pure code regain the speed of no-code, without any of its technical ceilings. Today I build with [Next.js and React](/en/services/hire-react-nextjs-developer-madagascar) and with [Python plus AI agents](/en/services/python-ai-developer-madagascar) as permanent copilot. Same delivery speed as before, depth of a real fullstack dev.

Current positioning: fullstack JavaScript developer based in Madagascar, with a [no-code and low-code dual culture](/en/services/low-code-developer-madagascar) few freelancers combine. Whether you're aiming for a high-performance website, well-ranked on Google and cited by AI (SEO + GEO), a [Next.js + Supabase SaaS to ship in weeks](/en/services/nextjs-supabase-developer-madagascar), or AI agents integrated into your existing product, that's exactly what I deliver daily from Madagascar.

items.title: ScalApp
items.subtitle: Automated Venture Management
items.description: Full-featured platform built for ScalApp, a France-based no-code development agency. The project includes a premium showcase website with smooth animations, an investment management dashboard enabling real-time portfolio tracking for clients, and automated API bridges connecting multiple financial data sources. The custom admin interface provides a consolidated performance overview. Pixel-perfect design crafted in Figma, then developed on Webflow with constant attention to detail and user experience.

items.title: ImmoPrive
items.subtitle: Real Estate Marketplace
items.description: Comprehensive real estate marketplace connecting buyers and sellers in real time on the French market. The platform features advanced geolocation search with an interactive map, detailed property listings with HD photo galleries, a built-in messaging system between buyers and sellers, and secure payments via Stripe. The back-office allows agents to manage their listings, track leads, and analyze performance metrics. Over 200 active listings within the first month of launch. Entirely built on Bubble.

items.title: n8n automation workflow showcase
items.subtitle: n8n automation workflow showcase
items.description:
I took my 7 most useful n8n use cases for B2B and made them playable live on a single interface.

On the menu:
• LinkedIn lead generation with AI ICP scoring (5 profiles in 37s)
• French prospect search on official INSEE/INPI data (free, unlimited)
• Email + InMail + connection request generation in 3 variants
• LinkedIn text post + HD visual in one click (Gemini 2.5 Flash Image)
• LinkedIn profile enrichment with quota management
• Free vs HD image comparator side by side
• AI chat agent that qualifies, books meetings and sends emails

Everything runs on self-hosted n8n (Contabo VPS + Coolify), with Apify, Groq, Gemini and the recherche-entreprises gov API. Cost per run: between $0 and $0.12.

The goal: show what you can ship fast with n8n, and provide a ready-to-plug base for a CRM or an internal client tool.

→ Demos playable without signup at the project link.

items.title: Yalee Creek Ranch
items.subtitle: Property Management
items.description: Turnkey property management application built for Yalee Creek Ranch, a Texas-based estate. The owner dashboard centralizes reservation tracking with an interactive calendar, automated rent collection, dynamic generation of custom lease contracts, and automated payment reminders via email. The system also handles maintenance requests and a complete history for each tenant. Built on Bubble with a Figma design, streamlining daily multi-unit rental management without any technical skills required.

items.title: Alchiimy
items.subtitle: AI Dating App
items.description: Alchiimy is a next-generation dating app that goes beyond appearances. The Alchiimy app uses an advanced AI matching algorithm based on emotional and intellectual compatibility, analyzing each user's interests, values, and life goals. The Alchiimy platform offers verified profiles, a step-by-step guided conversation system to build authentic connections before the first date, and themed group events. The UX was entirely designed to encourage real-life meetups over endless swiping. Built on Bubble with special attention to data privacy and security.

items.title: Artigen
items.subtitle: AI Image Generator
items.description: AI-powered image generator — completely free with no creation limits. Users describe their idea in text and receive an HD image in seconds. The fullstack architecture relies on Next.js for the frontend and FastAPI (Python) for the backend, with a smart queue system capable of handling 50 to 100 concurrent users even on free-tier hosting. The project includes a generation history, artistic style presets, and a high-resolution mode. Deployed on Vercel (frontend) and Render (API), achieving near-permanent uptime with zero infrastructure costs.

items.title: Factumation
items.subtitle: Invoicing Software
items.description: Online invoicing software designed for freelancers, self-employed professionals, and SMBs in Madagascar and Europe. Factumation lets you create polished invoices and quotes in seconds with an intuitive editor, export them as professional ready-to-send PDFs, and connect your business tools via Webhook for automated accounting. The software is 100% free, with no complex signup and no credit card required. It features multi-currency support (Ariary, Euro), payment tracking, and automated reminders. A flagship project entirely built with Claude Code and automated via N8N, showcasing the power of AI in software development.

items.title: Portfolio Webflow
items.subtitle: My previous personal portfolio
items.description: First professional portfolio built on Webflow, showcasing my no-code development, N8N automation and AI integration services. The site features a projects section, a technical toolkit overview and a contact system. Clean design with red accents and bold typography, optimized for client conversion. This portfolio served as my main showcase on LinkedIn and freelance platforms before the full Next.js redesign.

items.title: Scraping FlowRemote
items.subtitle: Job Listing Automation
items.description: Comprehensive N8N workflow that automatically scrapes new remote job listings published on FlowRemote. The system extracts HTML data from each listing (title, company, salary, location, publication date), structures it cleanly, then filters results based on custom criteria. Relevant offers are sent daily via Gmail with professional formatting. The workflow includes a date filter to surface only recent listings and avoid duplicates. Zero manual intervention required — the pipeline runs continuously and adapts automatically to site structure changes.

items.title: Visitor Tracking
items.subtitle: Real-time Analytics
items.description: Real-time visitor tracking system designed to monitor website traffic without relying on Google Analytics. Every visit is automatically captured via a webhook, precisely geolocated (country, city, IP address, ISP), and stored in a structured Airtable database. The N8N workflow filters known IPs to avoid duplicates, enriches data with Webflow CMS information, and feeds an Airtable dashboard with advanced filters. Ideal for analyzing traffic in real time, identifying returning visitors, understanding the geographic origin of your audience, and optimizing conversion rates.

items.question: What are the typical delivery timelines?
items.answer: A simple N8N workflow is delivered in 3 to 5 days. A full application (marketplace or dashboard type) takes 4 to 8 weeks. I always commit to a precise timeline before starting.

items.question: Do you work with international clients?
items.answer: Absolutely. I work with clients in France, the United States, and Madagascar. Communication is in French, using tools like Slack, Notion, and Google Meet for real-time collaboration.

items.question: What support do you offer after delivery?
items.answer: Every project includes 30 days of free post-delivery support for adjustments and bug fixes. Beyond that, I offer monthly maintenance contracts to ensure the longevity of your systems.

items.question: What technologies do you use?
items.answer: My core stack: Next.js and React for frontend, Supabase and Neon for backend, n8n for workflow automation, Python (FastAPI) for AI APIs, Claude Code and LLMs for intelligent agent integration. I always choose the technology best suited to your needs.

about.title: About Manda
about.subtitle: Full Stack Developer · AI Architect · Automation Builder
about.bio: I'm Mandaniaina Randriambinintsoa, freelance developer based in Antananarivo. Trained in Computer Science (Master's, ESTI), I started with JavaScript development. In 2023 I moved to No-Code, Bubble and Webflow, because it let me ship working products in a few weeks. That worked well for three years. Late 2025, AI-assisted development changed the game. I went back to pure code, because code is still the most flexible option when you need to configure servers, build real architecture and handle scale. My stack today: React and Next.js on the front, Supabase and Neon on the back, n8n and Python for automation.
about.philosophy: Creating a work of art is not the result of chance—it's the result of imagination, hard work, and determination.
